يلتبس (form VIII)

# يُلْتَبَسُ (yultabasu) /jul.ta.ba.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# يَلْتَبِسَ (yaltabisa) /jal.ta.bi.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
